description: partner_redirect_mode on connect links, added by SendSeven after the vendored spec. Copied from the live spec until it is vendored; remove this patch then.

partner_redirect_mode.title: Partner Redirect Mode
partner_redirect_mode.description: How the partner redirect is offered after a successful connection: `button` (default when a redirect URL is set) shows a 'Return to {partner}' button; `auto_after_first` redirects automatically after the first successful connection. Ignored (stored as null) when no partner_redirect_url is given.

partner_redirect_mode.title: Partner Redirect Mode
partner_redirect_mode.description: `button` or `auto_after_first`. Null when no partner_redirect_url is set; legacy links with a URL but no stored mode report `button`.
